observations.why: Imperative verb 'Forget' issues a direct command to discard knowledge, performing coercive pressure through insistent demand rather than reasoned persuasion.
Imperative 'Remove' repeats the same coercive insistence — a demand to eliminate knowledge, not a request or argument.

mints.name: ImperativeKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker here commanding erasure of held knowledge as a coercive demand, rather than requesting or persuading?
